entry_route.value: Applicants can go straight from a bachelor's without a master's, and the program also admits master's holders.
entry_route.quote: Applicants who have completed a bachelor’s degree and wish to pursue a doctoral degree without completing a master’s degree may apply for admission.

gre_general.value: Needed for unconditional admission: at least 146 Verbal and 159 Quantitative. A high TOEFL can offset a low verbal score.
gre_general.quote: A GRE score of at least 146 (verbal) and 159 (quantitative).

also.quote: A waiver of the Graduate Record Exam may be considered for a UT Arlington graduate who graduated within the past three years

funding.value: Scholarships and fellowships are awarded by relative standing among qualified applicants.
funding.quote: Award of scholarships or fellowships will be based on the student’s relative standing with respect to other qualified applicants.

supervisor.value: BS-entry students need a faculty advisor before their second full semester, which is not an admission rule.

gre_subject.value: No subject test is named for materials science.

deadline.value: The page gives no application deadline.

notes: The department gives preference to TOEFL iBT 84 (sections 22/21/20/20) or IELTS 6.5; these are preferences, so the university minimums stay. The GRE waiver is limited to UT Arlington graduates within three years.
name: Materials Science and Engineering PhD
